caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden grandfather clock with a square clock face at the top. The clock face has a white background with black Roman numerals and two black clock hands. The surrounding case of the clock face is brown wood with light brown or yellowish decorative trim. The body of the clock is elongated and features two diamond-shaped motifs in the middle section, with alternating dark brown and yellowish-brown colors. The door of the clock case has a small round knob on the left side. The base of the clock is sturdy with curved cutouts for legs. The entire object is rendered in various shades of brown, representing the wood grain, with some areas highlighted for depth. The background is a plain light beige color, and the name "ULRICH FISCHER" is written in the bottom left corner in small capital letters.
title: Shelf Clock
